source: Daily META review: hypotheses and capability experiments, not implemented game improvements

items.hypothesis: closestOpponent scans the entity list per live entity, and each simulation step pivots models and refreshes status; aggregate load may cause spikes on a baseline phone. No device slowdown has been observed.
items.experiment: Capture an idle baseline and a 10–15 minute private-test session with 1–4 active workshops and increasing legal unit counts. Record device/OS, exact source/place version, entity counts, MicroProfiler frame traces, memory, input latency and thermal trend. Keep viewport-emulator results separate.
items.success_evidence: Pre-register a frame/memory budget for the experiment, measure frame-time p50/p95/p99 and errors, and compare like-for-like loads before proposing a change. This does not change existing release gates.
items.requires: A secure hosted/device runner and authorized private-test access. No Roblox execution connector or universe/place IDs in the inspected project manifest; no credential read/activation performed.

items.next: Already main-integrated; do not recreate or request owner approval. Real-engine collision evidence is still missing.
items.verified_source: Current main server has three explicit CanCollide=true floor assignments; config marks PR38 merged.

items.hypothesis: The enemy timer resets to 2.3 after subtracting dt. Repeated overshoot may be discarded, analogous to the production cadence defect already fixed by PR45; this is not yet a measured gameplay defect.
items.source_observation: Current main uses state.enemyTimer=2.3, while productionTimer preserves negative remainder by adding 3.0.
items.experiment: Execute the canonical complete server through the accepted harness with regular and jittered Heartbeat inputs; record actual first-wave spawn timestamps while preventing combat/production from invalidating the fixture. Do not copy simulate or callbacks into the test.
items.success_evidence: First demonstrate repeatable cumulative cadence drift versus the intended 2.3 interval beyond one simulation-step tolerance. Only if reproduced, propose a minimal carry fix with the pinned old-source negative control. Preserve wave size, grace periods, unit balance and existing regressions.
items.requires_engine_evidence: Then confirm actual server spawn times in a private engine run; offline timing is not Roblox scheduling proof.

items.hypothesis: Version-specific Open Cloud Luau tasks could establish engine startup and scene-property evidence without owner PC work, but do not establish mobile or two-client behavior.
items.experiment: When a secure authorized connector and test universe/place/version are available, run the exact canonical scene build against an unpublished private test version; collect versioned source hashes, startup logs and three floor properties. Keep two-client and physical-phone evidence as separate required experiments.
items.success_evidence: Dated authenticated engine task result tied to exact source/place version, with logs and property assertions; no publish, model API or credentials in artifacts.
items.observed_gap: Available tool registry has no Roblox execution connector; inspected studio_autopilot/projects/toy_wars.json has no universe/place/version binding. No execution request or secret inspection performed.
